title: PR #129: docs(catalog): add decentralized crypto service candidate contracts
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Purpose
Add a machine-readable and human-readable catalog candidate for the proposed decentralized crypto service.

## Catalog changes
- Add `COMP-CRYPTO-SERVICE` as an architecture/integration candidate only.
- Add seven candidate function contracts: wallet access/signing, payment submission, finality query, RPC discovery, indexer query, SDK conformance, and cross-chain adapter boundary.
- Check candidate IDs against the current `main` catalog before insertion; no collisions found.
- Keep the catalog release decision `BLOCKED`.

## Source reconciliation
- Wallet access/signing is source-mapped to `Wallet::{address,sign_transaction}` at `a-townchain` SHA `a5e689671b1870699c7a1750f8a166e83590a41c`, blob `ab7edae3844277b8c9c7596e3b2bfa1c47c9b816`. This is not functional verification and does not imply hosted custody.
- SDK conformance is linked to a specification/gap record only; no conformance implementation is claimed.
- Payment submission and RPC discovery are `BLOCKED` with unresolved source bindings.
- Finality query, indexer query, and cross-chain adapter are `BLOCKED` for the reasons documented in the catalog.
- Bidirectional source-to-catalog reconciliation is not complete. This PR does not claim catalog completeness or production readiness.

## Validation gates
- Await exact-head GitHub Actions validator and source-census results.
- Any missing, pending, skipped, or inaccessible check remains residual.
- No auto-merge, no gate weakening, no implementation ownership transfer.

Related: [catalog source audit #112](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/112), [crypto service architecture #128](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/128), [cross-chain interoperability #126](https://github.com/A-TownChain-Okosystems/a-townchain-ecosystem/issues/126).

A-Town watermark: Globus OS / A-TownChain.
